name: GIRDER 格拉德 Titanium gravel 2025 SRAM Apex XPLR AXS
why_interesting: GIRDER's current titanium gravel complete: 3Al-2.5V frame, 3D-printed titanium fork crown, T47, UDH and SRAM Apex XPLR AXS 1×12 on 45C tires; the official page leaves the price blank.

facts.drivetrain: SRAM Apex XPLR AXS electronic 1×12; Adler Augen AC3 carbon crankset with CNC 7075 aluminium 42T narrow-wide chainring, SRAM 11-44T cassette, SRAM Apex 12-speed chain; crank length not listed
facts.brakes: SRAM Apex AXS hydraulic disc (written 'APX AXS')
facts.frame: 700C titanium gravel frame, internal routing, 12 mm thru-axles front and rear, UDH dropout, full anodized finish with hand engraving; titanium fork with 3D-printed integrated crown and 12 mm thru-axle
facts.frame_material: 3Al-2.5V titanium frame; titanium fork with a 3D-printed integrated crown; tube butting and wall thickness are not published
facts.frame_construction: Welded titanium frame; fork crown 3D-printed; anodized and hand-engraved finish
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 86.5 mm shell width, 52×52 mm bearing cups
facts.wheels: Aluminium double-wall rims, four-bearing thru-axle hubs
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×45C fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 516.9/387.8, S 543.2/401.2, M 574.2/413.4, L 598.6/419.3; seat angle 74°, head angle 70°, chainstay 425 mm, BB drop 69 mm, wheelbase 1018.1–1079.4 mm, head tube 85–172 mm, fork length 407 mm, offset 45 mm
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
